name: @tsdml/compiler
description: TSDML native compiler (Rust + napi-rs). Parses DML source into a DML-AST and (later) generates TSDML/runtime calls. Compiled to a platform .node binary; no JS/TS in the compiler.

scripts.build: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path crates/napi-binding/Cargo.toml && tsdown && node scripts/copy-node.mjs
scripts.build:debug: napi build --platform --manifest-path crates/napi-binding/Cargo.toml && tsdown && node scripts/copy-node.mjs
